info.title: The refusal codes of the contract directory

CONTRACT_CODES.description: The refusals of the contract-directory reader and of the links check (docs/contract-dir.md), by the code a refusal is printed with. A code is never reworded.

oneOf.title: dirAbsent
oneOf.description: no contract directory was found, or the one named does not exist
oneOf.x-text: No contract directory was found at {path}. Point --contract-dir, OMX_CONTRACT_PATH or pkg-config at it.

oneOf.title: manifestAbsent
oneOf.description: a package directory holds no MANIFEST.json
oneOf.x-text: The package directory {path} has no MANIFEST.json. Add one that lists its files.

oneOf.title: manifestInvalid
oneOf.description: a manifest is not JSON, lacks a field, or names another package or schema major than its place
oneOf.x-text: The manifest at {path} does not match the package it describes. Fix the field the detail names.

oneOf.title: manifestMismatch
oneOf.description: a listed file is missing, a file is present but not listed, or its hash differs
oneOf.x-text: The manifest at {path} and the files installed beside it disagree. Regenerate the manifest from what is actually installed.

oneOf.title: schemaMajor
oneOf.description: a file's $schema is not the installed form of the reader's schema major
oneOf.x-text: The file at {path} names a schema major this reader does not read. Install it under the major this reader expects.

oneOf.title: schemaTooOld
oneOf.description: retired, never raised since the devel wave 2026-11-24: requires names packages with no version, so no schema floor is read
oneOf.x-text: Retired code, never raised: {path} was read against an omx-contract schema floor, and since the devel wave 2026-11-24 requires names packages with no version.

oneOf.title: schemaFloorAbsent
oneOf.description: retired, never raised since the devel wave 2026-11-24: a file states no schema floor, and requires names packages with no version
oneOf.x-text: Retired code, never raised: {path} states no omx-contract schema floor, and since the devel wave 2026-11-24 none is needed; requires names packages with no version.

oneOf.title: fileNotJson
oneOf.description: a file does not parse
oneOf.x-text: The file at {path} does not parse as JSON. Fix its syntax.

oneOf.title: fileInvalid
oneOf.description: a file breaks the schema or the kernel-file shape, an unknown key or word included
oneOf.x-text: The file at {path} breaks the schema or the kernel-file shape. Fix the field the detail names.

oneOf.title: itemDuplicate
oneOf.description: two files declare one name
oneOf.x-text: {item} is declared by two files. Remove the duplicate so only one package declares it.

oneOf.title: kernelDuplicate
oneOf.description: two packages each declare a file of one kernel
oneOf.x-text: Kernel {kernel} is declared by two packages. Keep the declaration in one package only.

oneOf.title: refUnresolved
oneOf.description: a reference names no item
oneOf.x-text: {ref} refers to a name no installed file declares. Install the file that declares it, or fix the reference.

oneOf.title: refUndeclared
oneOf.description: a reference names an item of a package the file does not require
oneOf.x-text: {ref} refers to an item of a package its file does not require. Add that package to requires.

oneOf.title: verbDuplicate
oneOf.description: two verbs items, of one package or two, declare one verb: a verb has one owner
oneOf.x-text: Verb {verb} is declared by more than one package or item. A verb has one owner: remove the extra declaration.

oneOf.title: verbFormat
oneOf.description: a verb's format does not start with the verb it declares
oneOf.x-text: Verb {verb}'s format does not start with the verb itself. Rename the format to start with {verb}.

oneOf.title: verbHostUnknown
oneOf.description: a verb's implementedBy names a host that is no word of HOSTING_VERB_HOSTS
oneOf.x-text: Verb {verb} names a host that is not a word of HOSTING_VERB_HOSTS. Add the host there, or fix the verb’s implementedBy.

oneOf.title: verbCodeUnknown
oneOf.description: a verb's code names an item that is no codes item, or a name that item does not carry
oneOf.x-text: Verb {verb} names a code no codes item carries. Fix the code name, or add it where the codes item declares its codes.

oneOf.title: roleDuplicate
oneOf.description: two roleMeanings items, of one package or two, declare one role: a role has one owner
oneOf.x-text: Role {role} is declared by more than one package or item. A role has one owner: remove the extra declaration.

oneOf.title: packageAbsent
oneOf.description: a package the consumer or a file requires is not installed
oneOf.x-text: {package} is required and is not installed. Install it beside the files that require it.

oneOf.title: packageTooOld
oneOf.description: a required package is installed below its floor
oneOf.x-text: {package} is installed below the version required of it. Upgrade it to the required version.

oneOf.title: requiresUnresolved
oneOf.description: translate --owner reads a tree whose files require a package that neither OMX_CONTRACT_PATH nor the installed directory holds (or holds below the floor)
oneOf.x-text: {requirement} is required by this tree and was found nowhere: looked in {places}. Run the --installed form with OMX_CONTRACT_PATH naming a directory that holds it.

oneOf.title: ownerCodesUnlocated
oneOf.description: translate --owner reads a tree whose catalogs hold keys and whose declared code locations hold no code or word
oneOf.x-text: No code or word of this tree was found in {places}, though its catalogs hold keys. Declare the codes under data/ or in schema/codes.json.

oneOf.title: originMisplaced
oneOf.description: a scanned plugin descriptor is installed in the contract directory: a scan is never read as a declaration
oneOf.x-text: A scanned plugin descriptor is installed in the contract directory at {path}. Remove it: a scan is never a declaration.

oneOf.title: descriptorOriginSource
oneOf.description: an authored descriptor with no impl link, or a built or scanned one with a control that has no from link
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} has a control with no source link. An authored descriptor needs an impl link; a built or scanned one needs a from link on every control.

oneOf.title: descriptorUnknownAuthored
oneOf.description: an authored descriptor with a unit, a scale or a meaning of unknown
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} is authored and leaves a control's unit, scale or meaning as unknown. State it, or mark the descriptor built or scanned instead.

oneOf.title: descriptorControlDuplicate
oneOf.description: two controls of a descriptor with one id, one name or one symbol
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} declares two controls with the same id, name or symbol. Give each control its own.

oneOf.title: descriptorEasy
oneOf.description: an easy list that names no control, names one twice or a hidden or read-only one, or stands in a scanned descriptor
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor}'s easy list names no control, names one twice, names a hidden or read-only control, or appears in a scanned descriptor. Fix the easy list.

oneOf.title: descriptorIntegrity
oneOf.description: an integrity block whose version is not the plugin's own, or on a plugin that states no version
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor}'s integrity names another version than the plugin states. Regenerate the descriptor from the build it describes.

oneOf.title: descriptorMeter
oneOf.description: a meter of a descriptor with the id or a symbol of another meter, a symbol a control answers to, a range whose min is not below its max, a scale that is no id of PARAM_SCALES, a unit the kind does not measure in (level: dBFS, dBTP, LUFS, LU; gain-reduction: dB), a measurement in a unit it is not measured in, or a clip word on a gain reduction or a true clip on a loudness
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} has a meter whose id, symbol, range, scale or unit is wrong for its kind. Fix the meter the detail names.

oneOf.title: descriptorPortDuplicate
oneOf.description: two ports of a descriptor of one kind and direction with one id
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} declares two ports of the same kind and direction with one id. Give each port its own id.

oneOf.title: descriptorRange
oneOf.description: a travel whose min is above its max, whose step is negative, or whose default lies outside it
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} has a travel whose min, max, step or default is out of order. Fix the travel the detail names.

oneOf.title: descriptorChoice
oneOf.description: a choice whose default is not one of its ids, or whose labels or values are not one per id
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} has a choice whose default is not one of its ids, or whose labels or values do not match its ids one for one. Fix the choice the detail names.

oneOf.title: descriptorScale
oneOf.description: a scale that is neither an id of PARAM_SCALES nor unknown
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} names a scale that is neither an id of PARAM_SCALES nor unknown. Fix the scale name, or add it to PARAM_SCALES.

oneOf.title: descriptorPortWords
oneOf.description: a layout word on a port that is not audio, dialects off a note port or missing on one, or a layout its channels contradict
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} has a port whose layout, dialect or channel words contradict each other. Fix the port the detail names.

oneOf.title: descriptorInstrument
oneOf.description: an instrument block without the instrument feature or the reverse, or an instrument with no note or MIDI input or no audio output
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} declares an instrument block without the instrument feature (or the reverse), or an instrument with no note or MIDI input or no audio output. Fix the instrument declaration.

oneOf.title: descriptorWhen
oneOf.description: a when that names no choice of the descriptor, or an id that choice does not have
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} has a when that names no choice of the descriptor, or an id that choice does not have. Fix the when the detail names.

oneOf.title: descriptorFaceDiffers
oneOf.description: a plugin's built face, scanned as a host scans it, states other than its authored descriptor; raised by the owner's face check, since the reader compares no faces
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor}’s built face states other than what it is authored as. Update the authored descriptor, or fix the build.

oneOf.title: overridePluginMismatch
oneOf.description: an override file whose plugin id or format is not the plugin it is applied to: the file is refused whole
oneOf.x-text: The override at {path} names a plugin id or format other than the plugin it is applied to. The whole file is refused: fix which plugin it targets.

oneOf.title: overrideControlAbsent
oneOf.description: an override entry that names a control the descriptor does not have: the entry is dropped
oneOf.x-text: The override at {path} names a control the descriptor does not have. That entry is dropped: remove it, or fix the control name.

oneOf.title: overrideWidens
oneOf.description: an override entry whose travel end lies outside the plugin's ends, or whose default lies outside the travel: the entry is dropped
oneOf.x-text: The override at {path} has a travel end outside the plugin's ends, or a default outside the travel. That entry is dropped: bring it inside the plugin's own range.

oneOf.title: overrideKindMismatch
oneOf.description: an override entry with a word that does not fit the control's kind (a travel or a map on a choice) or its family (a band without family eq and an EQ meaning): the entry is dropped
oneOf.x-text: The override at {path} has a word that does not fit the control’s kind or family. That entry is dropped: fix the word, or the control it is applied to.

oneOf.title: overrideScaleFloor
oneOf.description: an override entry with a log scale over a floor that is not positive: the entry is dropped
oneOf.x-text: The override at {path} sets a log scale over a floor that is not positive. That entry is dropped: use a positive floor.

oneOf.title: overrideMapInvalid
oneOf.description: an override map that is not strictly monotonic, does not cover the plugin's ends or lies outside them: the entry is dropped
oneOf.x-text: The override at {path} has a map that is not strictly monotonic, or does not cover the plugin’s ends. That entry is dropped: fix the map.

oneOf.title: overrideBasisEvidence
oneOf.description: an override entry with basis measured and no evidence, or evidence with another basis: the entry is dropped
oneOf.x-text: The override at {path} states basis measured with no evidence, or evidence with another basis. That entry is dropped: add the matching evidence, or change the basis.

oneOf.title: overrideFingerprintDiffers
oneOf.description: an override file written against another control list than the descriptor's: a warning, the entries that still hold are applied
oneOf.x-text: The override at {path} was written against another control list than the descriptor's. The entries that still fit are applied; review the rest.

oneOf.title: sourceAbsent
oneOf.description: a link's path does not exist
oneOf.x-text: The path a link names, {path}, does not exist. Fix the link's path.

oneOf.title: sourceSymbolAbsent
oneOf.description: the path holds no definition of the link's symbol
oneOf.x-text: {path} holds no definition of the symbol a link names. Fix the symbol name, or point the link elsewhere.

oneOf.title: sourceAmbiguous
oneOf.description: the path defines the link's symbol more than once
oneOf.x-text: {path} defines the symbol a link names more than once. Make the definition unique, or narrow the link.

oneOf.title: sourceDiffers
oneOf.description: the value at a from link is not the declared value
oneOf.x-text: The value at {path}'s from link is not the value declared beside it. Update the declared value to match, or fix the link.

oneOf.title: sourceUnevaluable
oneOf.description: a from link whose value the tool cannot read
oneOf.x-text: The value at {path}'s from link cannot be read by this tool. Simplify the source, or state the value by hand and drop the link.

oneOf.title: sourceUnread
oneOf.description: an impl link whose definition does not name the item
oneOf.x-text: The definition at {path}'s impl link does not name the item it is linked from. Point the link at the definition that actually names it.

oneOf.title: sourceNone
oneOf.description: an item with no impl link, where every item must carry one
oneOf.x-text: {item} carries no impl link, and every item of its kind must carry one. Add the link to where it is defined.

oneOf.title: itemUnknown
oneOf.description: a domain function was asked for an item the domain does not declare
oneOf.x-text: {item} is not an item of the domain {domain}. Ask for an item the domain declares.

oneOf.title: wordUnknown
oneOf.description: a domain function was asked for a word, or a range name, the item does not declare
oneOf.x-text: {word} is not a word or a name of the item {item}. Ask for one the item declares.

oneOf.title: indexRange
oneOf.description: a domain function was asked for a word at an index past the item's count
oneOf.x-text: Index {index} is past the end of the item {item}, which has {count} words. Ask for an index below the count.

oneOf.title: itemPrefix
oneOf.description: an item of a domain does not start with its domain's name, or starts with the name of a longer domain
oneOf.x-text: {item} breaks the naming of the domain {domain}. Start an item name with the domain's name in upper snake case and an underscore, and with no longer domain's name.

oneOf.title: catalogInvalid
oneOf.description: a domain's catalog is not a regular file named by a language tag, or is not an object of {text, by} entries
oneOf.x-text: The catalog at {path} cannot be read as a catalog of its domain. Fix the file or its name the detail points to.

oneOf.title: descriptorLatency
oneOf.description: a latency sweep whose min is above its max, or a latency ref to an item that is no scalar in frames or ms
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} declares a latency whose sweep has its min above its max, or a latency ref to an item that is no scalar in frames or ms. Fix the latency the detail names.

oneOf.title: descriptorUnitDuplicate
oneOf.description: a unit of the descriptor's own units whose id or symbol is that of a PARAM_UNITS unit, or of another of its own units
oneOf.x-text: {descriptor} declares a unit of its own whose id or symbol is that of a standard unit, or of another of its own units. Give the unit an id and a symbol of its own, or state the standard unit.
